justification: Critical: a new production endpoint that returns a regulatory determination (EXCLUDED / NOT_EXCLUDED_BY_CHECKED_CRITERIA) and a production data migration. The design goal is a hard authority boundary: no result unless each standard's provision IDs, exact quote, legislation.nsw.gov.au source URL and PDF page all validate.

pre_impl.existing_data: cdc_eligibility_standards ids 1-3 (verified 2026-07-27) cite regulatory_provisions 36996/36997 (PDF p112/113) and 36184/36185 (p23). Their quotes and 3.1(3) paragraphs match the law in force fetched from legislation.nsw.gov.au 2026-10-07; the cited R2 PDF (454 pp) carries that text on those pages.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: documents.source_url was NULL for the cited Codes SEPP document (authority incomplete); parse_controls keeps only the first zone/ASS class of a property (split zoning hidden); the lot_dimensions frontage is a documented shorter-side heuristic, not a building-line width; instrument_registry says 15 May 2026 while the live page's point-in-time is 11 September 2026.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Reuses resolve_address (GATE-0), layerintersect, the Valuer General service, the cadastre lot and lot_dimensions scale correction. Legacy /pipeline/cdc/screen and the other CDC surfaces are untouched and not covered.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Planning Portal / Valuer General / cadastre outages: _portal_get and get_valuation return None, so the affected criterion is UNKNOWN; resolve_address raising becomes UNKNOWN for all four criteria; a database error loading authority becomes UNAVAILABLE (HTTP 503).
pre_impl.frontend_type: No frontend change. The endpoint returns JSON: result string, criteria[] with outcome/input/rule/comparison/authority evidence; HTTP 503 body for UNAVAILABLE.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: A caller sees UNKNOWN or UNAVAILABLE with a named reason (e.g. 'the property comprises 8 lots', 'standard 7 is not manually verified'); no failure path yields EXCLUDED or NOT_EXCLUDED_BY_CHECKED_CRITERIA.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Any fail-closed path yields a determination: verified by four mutations (UNKNOWN->NOT_EXCLUDED, source-URL check removed, quote-match removed, malformed area dropped); each produced 1-3 failing tests.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Observed 2026-10-07: mutating overall() so UNKNOWN reads as NOT_EXCLUDED -> 3 failed; removing the source-URL check -> 2 failed; removing the quote-match check -> 1 failed; dropping a malformed area instead of UNKNOWN -> 3 failed. Restored code: 105 passed.

functions.name: validate_authority
functions.input: active cdc_eligibility_standards rows plus every cited regulatory_provisions row and its documents row
functions.output: a ValidatedAuthority holding all four standards with their evidence, or a tuple of named failures
functions.if_none: No standards, provisions or documents returned -> a failure per standard -> UNAVAILABLE; nothing is evaluated.

functions.name: evaluate
functions.input: a ValidatedAuthority from validate_authority plus a LotInputs of three-state property facts
functions.output: four CriterionResults (zone, lot_area, lot_width, acid_sulfate), each PASS, FAIL or UNKNOWN with evidence
functions.if_none: Passing None or any non-ValidatedAuthority raises TypeError; every None fact becomes that criterion's UNKNOWN.

functions.name: rectangle_width_range
functions.input: the Planning Portal cadastre lot geometry dict with one EPSG:3857 ring for a single lot
functions.output: (shortest, longest) side for a rectangle, else UNKNOWN
functions.if_none: No geometry, several rings, NaN coordinates or a non-rectangle -> (None, reason) -> lot_width UNKNOWN.

values.source: data-agreement/geometry tolerances, documented in code; not regulatory values. Every regulatory threshold comes from cdc_eligibility_standards.
values.read_at: module constants in services/cdc_lot_requirements.py and services/cdc_lot_inputs.py, read at evaluation time
values.if_missing: They are code constants and cannot be missing; regulatory thresholds are read from cdc_eligibility_standards and their absence is UNAVAILABLE.

queries.where_clause: code_name = 'housing_code' AND is_active AND standard_type = ANY(required four)
layer_type = 'acid_sulfate' AND ST_Intersects(lot); 15.6 ms via GIST (EXPLAIN ANALYZE)

break_it.scenario: A caller posts zone, eligible or another fact field to force a result
break_it.what_happens: The request model forbids extra fields so the request is rejected before any lookup

break_it.scenario: A split-zoned lot is read as only its first listed zone
break_it.what_happens: Every Land Zoning Map feature is read and a mix of listed and unlisted zones is UNKNOWN

break_it.scenario: Missing acid sulfate data read as Class 5
break_it.what_happens: Absence counts only inside a complete response that carries a zoning result; stored map copy cross-checked
break_it.repro: python -m pytest tests/test_cdc_lot_requirements.py -q -o addopts= -k parse_ass_blocks or combine_ass

break_it.scenario: Class 1/2 on part of a lot reported as excluded
break_it.what_happens: cl 1.19(6) allows development on the unaffected part
break_it.how: EXCLUDED only when >= 99.5% of the lot is Class 1/2

break_it.scenario: The bounding-box frontage is used as the building-line width for an irregular lot
break_it.what_happens: Width taken only from a true rectangle, as a min/max range
break_it.how: non-rectangle -> UNKNOWN; narrow rectangle -> UNKNOWN not FAIL (tested)
break_it.repro: python -m pytest tests/test_cdc_lot_requirements.py -q -o addopts= -k rectangle or width

break_it.scenario: The stored Codes SEPP text is older than the instrument version currently in force
break_it.what_happens: Not enforced by this endpoint because version currency is outside the four-item authority contract
break_it.how: Reported: instrument_registry 15 May 2026 vs live 11 September 2026
break_it.repro: SELECT current_version FROM instrument_registry WHERE instrument_key='sepp_exempt_complying_2008' -- compare with legislation_monitor._extract_latest_pit_date on the live page

break_it.scenario: The standards query returns zero rows, duplicate active rows, or an unverified or stale row
break_it.what_happens: validate_authority names the failing standard and the endpoint returns UNAVAILABLE with no criteria
break_it.how: one-active-per-type check, manual_verified and stale_since checks
break_it.repro: python -m pytest tests/test_cdc_lot_requirements.py -q -o addopts= -k 'duplicate or verified or stale or absent'

break_it.scenario: A cited provision or document row is missing, not current, has changed text, or lacks a source URL or page
break_it.what_happens: The quote no longer matches or a required evidence field is empty, so the endpoint returns UNAVAILABLE
break_it.how: provision existence, is_current, quote containment, source_url prefix and pdf_page checks
break_it.repro: python -m pytest tests/test_cdc_lot_requirements.py -q -o addopts= -k 'provision or source_url or pdf or quote'

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes: migration 082 applied 2026-10-07; the min_lot_width standard (id 7) must be manually verified by the founder before the endpoint returns anything but UNAVAILABLE.
